_notes.summary: Bridges cascade doctrine tags (from cascade_options.json) to strat game-mechanical tags (from stratagems.json). This is the missing link between what command decides and which stratagems surface. The cascade aggregates doctrine tags; this file tells the bot which strat game tags express each doctrine; the bot scores each eligible strat by summing the aggregate weight of every doctrine family it belongs to.
_notes.the_problem: Cascade doctrine tags (aggressive, terminus, resilience, etc.) and strat game tags (damage_boost, extremis, team, health, etc.) are entirely different vocabularies. Only 'terminus' appears in both. Without this mapping, the bot cannot score strats against the cascade aggregate.

scoring_algorithm.step_1: After all cascade picks close, the bot holds a doctrine_tag_aggregate: a dict of {doctrine_tag: float_weight}. Example: {aggressive: 9.5, terminus: 8.0, elimination: 5.0, faith: 3.0}.
scoring_algorithm.step_2: For each non-excluded, pool-eligible strat, compute a score. For each of the strat's game tags, look it up in this file's doctrine_families to get the list of doctrine tags it belongs to. For each matching doctrine tag, add aggregate_weight * tag_doctrine_multiplier to the strat's score.
scoring_algorithm.step_3: After scoring all strats, strip strats whose pool role is not represented among enlisted specialists this beat (e.g. if no Huntmaster enlisted, huntmaster-pool strats are not eligible).
scoring_algorithm.step_4: Apply conflict_map from stratagems.json — if two top-scoring strats conflict, the lower-scoring one is dropped from the pool.
scoring_algorithm.step_5: Present ranked candidate list to Watch Master for confirmation/veto. WM confirms or swaps any strat by name. Confirmed set becomes the locked strat pool.
scoring_algorithm.mandate_pass: From the locked pool, run three separate derivation passes (theatre, company, KT) each selecting the highest-scoring remaining strat for that tier's dominant doctrine tags. Mandate strats are guaranteed conflict-free with each other because pool is already conflict-stripped.
scoring_algorithm.tie_break: Equal-scoring strats: prefer the one whose pool roles are more broadly represented among enlisted specialists (more specialists = more buy-in). Secondary tiebreak: alphabetical.

_notes.tag_doctrine_multiplier_note: Each game tag → doctrine family mapping carries a multiplier (0.5–1.5) representing how directly that game tag expresses the doctrine. Direct expression = 1.0 or higher. Indirect = 0.5.

pool_blacklist._note: Strat names listed here are permanently excluded from campaign pool construction regardless of score. Useful for strats that are fine in casual play but should never be a campaign mandate. The bot still scores them internally so WM can see their rank — they are just excluded from the candidate list presented for confirmation. If WM explicitly names a blacklisted strat, the bot warns and allows a one-time override.
pool_blacklist._tuning: To exclude a strat: add an entry to 'entries' with the strat name as key and a brief reason as value. To re-enable: delete the entry.

aggressive._description: High offensive tempo, pushing damage, driving forward. Strats that make the kill team hit harder or move more aggressively.

terminus._description: Engaging hard targets, bosses, extremis threats. Strats that directly invoke, buff, or respond to terminus-class enemies.

elimination._description: Precision killing, high-stakes mechanics, no safety net. Strats that reward clean kills and punish mistakes — raising the stakes per engagement.

faith._description: Spiritual endurance, litany effects, shared brotherhood — the Watch fighting as one consecrated force.

resilience._description: Sustaining the squad through punishment — health, armour, healing, staying on the field longer.

recovery._description: Asset management — ammo, equipment, gene-seed, enemy salvage. Keeping the kill team operational across multiple engagements.

stealth._description: Precision, low footprint, surgical engagement. Ranged focus, marking targets, exploiting range windows.

intel._description: Battlefield awareness, knowing what comes, exploiting foreknowledge. Strats that reward or require reading the engagement.
intel._note: Battlefield Instincts (ui_disabled) scores for intel because it represents fighting without information — a forced-intel challenge.

void._description: Warp, psychic, Chaos-adjacent mechanics. Strats that invoke warp entities, cursed objects, or warp-biological effects.

tech._description: Machine doctrine, weapon systems, field engineering. Strats that modify weapons, manage systems, or leverage machine-spirit logic.

suppression._description: Controlling enemy wave composition, forcing the battlefield, denying enemy momentum through volume or area denial.

defensive._description: Holding position, protecting against punishment, enduring and not yielding. Strats that harden the squad or share the burden.

fortify._description: Consolidating and securing — not just surviving but making the position unassailable. Strats that lock down resources or sustain across multiple waves.

worked_example._note: Continuing the Aurum scenario from the walkthrough. All cascade picks submitted. Dominant doctrine aggregate:

theatre.tier_dominant_doctrine: aggregate-wide — all HC picks combined. Top tag: aggressive (9.5) + terminus (8.0). Picks highest-scoring strat from pool.
theatre.winner: Unleashed Fury (33.8) — but wait: it is champion pool only. If Company Champion is the relevant HC proxy for theatre... actually Theatre pass uses the FULL pool scored against the FULL aggregate. Highest scorer, no tier restriction for theatre strat.
theatre.actual_winner: Supremacy of the Strong (24.0) might beat Unleashed Fury if pool role gating is applied. champion pool is eligible (Company Champions are enlisted). So Unleashed Fury wins Theatre at 33.8.

company_primus.tier_dominant_doctrine: Company Primus picks only — Captain (aggressive, terminus, elimination) + Champion (elimination, terminus) + Chaplain (faith, aggressive, terminus) etc. Sub-aggregate more elimination-heavy than theatre.
company_primus.exclude_already_mandated: Unleashed Fury already taken for Theatre.
company_primus.winner: Supremacy of the Strong (24.0) — terminus-maxing strat. Fits Company Champion's Honour the Duel (elimination + terminus). Champion pool eligible.

kt_varen.tier_dominant_doctrine: Sgt's Oath of Moment (elimination, terminus, aggressive) + Judiciar's sentence + KT members' chapter weights.
kt_varen.exclude_already_mandated: Unleashed Fury and Supremacy of the Strong taken.
kt_varen.winner: You Only Live Once (21.5) — elimination at 1.5x, no-respawn pressure, death_mechanic. Direct expression of Oath of Moment's 'do not turn from it' language.
